2048.description: Slide, merge, reach the big one.
2048.author: Swirl
2048.tagline: Slide, merge, reach the big one.
2048.long: Slide the tiles around the board. Two tiles with the same number merge into one, double the value. Keep going until you reach 2048 - or run out of moves.\nArrow keys, WASD or a mouse swipe. R restarts. Your best score is saved.

assaultcube.author: The AssaultCube Team
assaultcube.title: AssaultCube
assaultcube.tagline: Fast, free, open-source team FPS with bots.
assaultcube.long: AssaultCube is a free, open-source first-person shooter built on the Cube engine, with 20+ maps, bots and classic arcade gunplay, running on SwirlOS through SwirlRun (software OpenGL).\nFirst launch unpacks the game data next to the game (this takes a minute). Uninstalling removes the downloaded files but not the unpacked data folder (packages) - delete it by hand to reclaim space. Tip: set a low resolution on slower machines.
assaultcube.license: Free (zlib-style / CC, see LICENSE and package_copyrights)

blocks.author: Swirl
blocks.title: Blocks
blocks.long: The falling-block puzzle you know. Rotate and place the pieces to make full lines, which vanish and score points. Every ten lines the pieces fall faster.\nArrows to move and rotate, Space for a hard drop, P to pause.

breakout.author: Swirl
breakout.title: Breakout
breakout.long: Bounce the ball off your paddle and smash every brick. Where the ball hits the paddle changes its angle, so aim your shots. Clear the wall for a faster, trickier next level.\nMove with the mouse or A and D. Click or Space to launch.

browser.description: A real web browser (WebKitGTK) running on SwirlOS's Linux layer.
browser.author: WebKit, Mesa, GTK and friends (Ubuntu 24.04 builds); SwirlOS bridge by Swirl
browser.title: Web Browser
browser.long: The WebKitGTK MiniBrowser from Ubuntu 24.04 running on the SwirlOS Linux layer, shown in a normal SwirlOS window.\nHTTP and HTTPS with certificate checking, modern HTML/CSS/JavaScript. Software rendering (Mesa llvmpipe), so it is slower than a desktop browser.\nBig download (about 400 MB) and needs the r84 kernel. Open it from the start menu (Web Browser).

checkers.description: Checkers with a computer opponent, forced captures, drag and drop, hints and undo. Native SwirlOS app.
checkers.author: Leonid
checkers.title: Checkers
checkers.tagline: Play checkers against the computer or a friend.
checkers.long:
English checkers for SwirlOS: forced captures, multi-jumps, kings, drag-and-drop or click-to-move, legal move markers, move list, captured pieces, undo, hints and a flippable board.
Play as White or Black against the computer on four levels (Beginner to Strong), or two players on one screen.
Mouse or keyboard: arrow keys move the cursor, Enter/Space selects and moves.
Shortcuts: N new game, U undo, F flip, H hint, L level, Esc cancel.

chess.description: Chess with a computer opponent, drag and drop, hints, ratings and undo. Native SwirlOS app.
chess.author: Leonid
chess.title: Chess
chess.tagline: Play chess against the computer or a friend.
chess.long:
A full chess game for SwirlOS: every rule (castling, en passant, promotion, check, checkmate, stalemate, draws by repetition, 50 moves and insufficient material), drag-and-drop or click-to-move, legal move hints, move list, captured pieces, undo, hints and a flippable board.
Play as White or Black against the computer on four levels (Beginner to Strong), or two players on one screen.
Mouse or keyboard: arrow keys move the cursor, Enter/Space selects and moves.
Shortcuts: N new game, U undo, F flip, H hint, L level, D input readout, Esc cancel.

classicube.description: Build and explore a blocky 3D world.
classicube.author: UnknownShadow200 (ClassiCube), ported to SwirlOS
classicube.title: ClassiCube
classicube.tagline: A Minecraft Classic-style sandbox, ported to SwirlOS.
classicube.long: ClassiCube is an open-source voxel sandbox in the spirit of Minecraft Classic. Place and break blocks, explore a generated world and build whatever you like. Runs on SwirlOS with the built-in software renderer, singleplayer only for now, no sound yet.\nWASD to move, mouse to look, Space to jump, B for the block menu, Esc for the menu. Worlds are saved in your ClassiCube folder.\nNote: uses the same memory region as DOOM, so don't run both at once. Needs SwirlOS r105 or newer for mouse look.

clipboard.author: qwerwasi6-lab
clipboard.title: Clipboard History
clipboard.tagline: Your last 5 copies. Star the ones worth keeping.
clipboard.long:
Keeps your last 5 copied texts in a list. Press Copy to put one back on the clipboard, or press the star to keep it forever. Starred entries are saved to /home/user/Clipboard/starred.txt.
The app records while it is open (minimised is fine).

cmatrix.description: Falling green code. Pure screensaver energy.
cmatrix.author: Swirl
cmatrix.title: Matrix
cmatrix.long: The falling-code rain, in its own window.\nC cycles colours (or press 1-6), + and - change the speed, Space pauses, R restarts. Resize the window to fill your screen.

coinflip.author: Leonid
coinflip.title: Coin Flip
coinflip.long: A simple virtual coin flipper. Great for making decisions.\nType: coinflip

cowsay.description: A talking cow for the terminal.
cowsay.author: Swirl
cowsay.title: Cowsay
cowsay.long:
The classic talking cow, now in the SwirlOS terminal.
Type: cowsay hello world
Or pick the penguin: cowsay -f tux I use SwirlOS btw
No message? The cow picks one for you.

doom.author: id Software
doom.title: DOOM
doom.long: The game that started it all. Fight through Knee-Deep in the Dead, the shareware episode, using SwirlOS's built-in DOOM engine.\nArrows to move, Ctrl to fire, Space to open doors, Esc for the menu.

doukutsu.description: Cave Story (Doukutsu Monogatari) - the freeware platformer by Studio Pixel.
doukutsu.author: Studio Pixel
doukutsu.title: Doukutsu
doukutsu.tagline: Cave Story, the legendary freeware platformer.
doukutsu.long: Wake up in a cave with no memory, meet the Mimigas, and take on the Doctor. Pixel-perfect run-and-gun exploration by Daisuke 'Pixel' Amaya, running on SwirlOS through SwirlRun.\nArrows to move, Z to jump, X to shoot, Q for the inventory. This package ships the English v1.2 freeware build; some later stages are not included yet.

launcher.description: Terminal command: l <name of game/app> finds the .elf and runs it.
launcher.title: Launcher
launcher.tagline: Type  l <name>  to launch any game or app
launcher.long: Adds the terminal command l (aliases: launch, launcher). Type l snake and Launcher finds the matching .elf by itself: it checks <folder>/<name>.elf, then a folder called <name> (whatever .elf is inside), then any file or folder whose name contains what you typed. Searches the games and apps folders and your home folder. Nothing is hardcoded per app.

lua.description: Lua 5.4 for the SwirlOS terminal: scripts, os.execute, a swirl library and an interactive prompt.
lua.author: Swirl
lua.title: Lua
lua.tagline: Run Lua scripts from the terminal.
lua.long:
Lua 5.4.9, the small fast scripting language.
Type: lua -run /home/user/hello.lua
Or straight from the prompt: lua -e print(1+1)
Run other programs with os.execute / io.popen, and use the swirl library to list folders, sleep, spawn and read system info. Interactive mode needs the terminal input patch. Docs: cat /system/doc/lua.txt

notes.description: Fast, simple notes with search and auto-save.
notes.author: Swirl
notes.title: Notes
notes.tagline: Write it down. It saves itself.
notes.long: A quick notes app for SwirlOS. Every note is a plain .txt file in /home/user/Notes, so you can open them anywhere.\nCtrl+N new note, Ctrl+F search, Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y undo and redo, Ctrl+V paste, Ctrl+D (twice) deletes the note. Click anywhere to place the cursor. Notes save automatically a moment after you stop typing.

quake.author: id Software
quake.title: Quake
quake.long: id Software's 1996 classic. Fight through Dimension of the Doomed, the shareware episode, running on SwirlOS through SwirlRun.\nWASD or arrows to move, mouse to look, Ctrl or left click to fire, Space to jump, Esc for the menu.

snake.author: Swirl
snake.title: Snake
snake.long: A classic reborn for SwirlOS. Guide the snake to the berries, grow longer with every bite and steer clear of the walls and your own tail. The faster you eat, the faster it gets.\nArrow keys or WASD to steer, Space to pause. Your best score is saved.

swirl-ide.description: Swirl IDE: a tabbed code editor for C and Lua with Check, Run and Stop buttons.
swirl-ide.author: Swirl
swirl-ide.title: Swirl IDE
swirl-ide.tagline: Write, build and run C and Lua without leaving the desktop.
swirl-ide.long:
A tabbed code editor for C and Lua: open as many files as you like (8 tabs), pick the language from the drop-down, and get line numbers, syntax colours, auto-indent, undo, find and go-to-line.
Check compiles or syntax-checks and lists errors (click one to jump to the line). Run builds and runs your program with its output right under the editor, and Stop ends it.
Ctrl+N new tab, Ctrl+O open, Ctrl+S save, Ctrl+B check, Ctrl+R run, Ctrl+F find, Ctrl+G go to line, Ctrl+Z undo, Ctrl+W close tab, Ctrl+PgUp/PgDn switch tabs.
Replaces Swirl C IDE. Needs the Tiny C Compiler and Lua packages, which the Store installs for you.

swirl-upgrade.description: Bridge for older installs: adds a 'swirl-upgrade' terminal command that updates the whole system to the latest release.
swirl-upgrade.author: Swirl
swirl-upgrade.title: SwirlOS Upgrade (r61/r62)
swirl-upgrade.tagline: Update an old install in place - keeps your files.
swirl-upgrade.long: Installs from before r63 cannot update themselves: they have no system manifest and an older spm. This package brings the new spm and one terminal command, swirl-upgrade. It compares every system file by content, downloads only what changed, verifies each file and swaps them in safely (a failed update rolls back). Your files in /home/user and your settings are never touched.\nYou must boot a SwirlOS r63+ ISO first - the kernel lives on the boot medium and cannot be updated from inside the OS.

swirlspin.description: The real SwirlOS logo, extruded into 3D and spinning.
swirlspin.author: Swirl
swirlspin.title: Swirl Spin
swirlspin.long: The real SwirlOS logo as a solid 3D shape, rotating in its own window.\nDrag with the mouse to spin it, Space pauses, + and - change the speed, C cycles colours (logo, neon, gold, mono), R resets.

tcc.description: Tiny C Compiler: compile and run C programs on SwirlOS.
tcc.author: Fabrice Bellard & the TinyCC developers (SwirlOS port by Swirl)
tcc.title: Tiny C Compiler
tcc.tagline: A whole C compiler in 360 KB.
tcc.long: TinyCC 0.9.28rc ported to SwirlOS. Compile C in memory and run it straight away (tcc -run file.c), or build object files. Comes with the libc headers and <swirl.h> for talking to the kernel directly.\nUse it from the terminal, or install the Swirl C IDE for an editor with Build & Run.

weather.description: Modern weather with forecast, photo background and live conditions.
weather.author: qwerwasi6-lab
weather.title: Weather
weather.tagline: Modern weather with forecast, photo background and live conditions
weather.long: Current conditions, 24-hour and 7-day forecast, city search, C/F toggle. Data by Open-Meteo.com (no API key). Needs internet.

welcome.description: Adds a 'welcome' terminal command with a short intro to spm.
welcome.author: qwerwasi6-lab
welcome.title: Welcome to spm
welcome.tagline: A friendly intro command for the terminal.

os.name: SwirlOS
os.notes: r115: real networking for Windows programs (winsock on kernel TCP/UDP: sockets, select, DNS, UDP bind/sendto/recvfrom) and a much faster software OpenGL rasterizer (fast textured spans)
